summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FREA! game new features: Performance Mode, Treasure Dig, Musical Chairs, and Copycat player leader. All major features are working correctly.

Performance Mode: Body class 'frea-lite' applied/removed correctly
Performance Mode: FreaPerf.resolved() returns correct values
Performance Mode: localStorage persistence works
Performance Mode: Game runs correctly in Lite mode
Treasure Dig: FreaDig module exists and accessible
Treasure Dig: Dirt block created with correct dimensions (75x47 cells)
Treasure Dig: Digging mechanics work (dugN increased from 31 to 123)
Treasure Dig: Player can collect treasure (2 coins collected)
Treasure Dig: tapWorld() creates dig targets
Treasure Dig: 22 treasures buried in dirt
Treasure Dig: Visual confirmation of dirt block, grass surface, boulders, and treasure icons

Musical Chairs: Music phase active with fleas marching
Musical Chairs: Visual confirmation of chairs in a row

performance_mode.details: All three performance levels (Auto, Lite, High) work correctly. Body class toggling, FreaPerf.resolved() API, and localStorage persistence all verified. Game successfully runs in Lite mode.

treasure_dig.details: Real dirt digging mechanics fully functional. Dirt block with 75x47 cells created. Digging increases dugN counter (31→123 observed). Player collected 2 coins and dug 15 cells. 22 treasures buried. Visual confirmation shows grass surface, gray boulders, and treasure icons (coins, gems, crowns). CPU fleas dig autonomously.

musical_chairs.details: Real chairs mode working correctly. 3 chairs created for 4 fleas (correct count = fleas-1). Chairs have proper properties (_chair, _face). Banner displays 'Musical Chairs'. Music phase active with fleas marching. Visual confirmation shows chairs in a row with fleas.

copycat_player_leader.details: Player can be set as leader via localStorage. Leader.isP correctly returns true. Phase 'await' when waiting for input. All 5 move buttons (hop, left, right, leap, crouch) and 15 action buttons present. Clicking hop button successfully triggers beat phase with seq: ['hop']. Visual UI shows leader perch, crown icon, and control pad.

regression.details: All tested modes (classic, race, sumo, koth, lava, hoops) start successfully without errors.
